description:
https://store.playstation.com/concept/10020348

Two astronauts. One moon. Zero chance of doing this alone.

Together: Moon Escape is a handcrafted co-op puzzle adventure built from the ground up for two players. Play online or in local split-screen. There is no single-player mode, because the Moon demands teamwork.

You are Moonfishers, working for Moontella, a trillion-dollar corporation harvesting rare lunar slime for luxury restaurants back on Earth. The job was simple. Then something went wrong.

Expect asymmetric puzzles where each of you sees something different, absurd tools like the Slime Fryer and the Slime Vision Goggles, and a lot of shouting at your partner after they fall into a crater again.

Available now on PlayStation 5.

Full voice acting in Spanish and Catalan.
Enhanced for PS5 Pro.

Our Ardennian automotive aficionado Hibi has returned to talk about a very special vehicle: the skim speeder!

The skim speeder is a new addition to the STAR WARS™ galaxy and is making its debut in STAR WARS: Galactic Racer™. While skim speeders may not be as agile as speeder bikes or as resilient as landspeeders, they represent the perfect balance between the two. They can build up momentum to become the fastest speeder on the track and can tackle sharp corners with their unique Knife Edge maneuver. Are you ready to spread your wings and soar across the track in the skim speeder? Watch the full episode to find out more and check back soon for Episode 4.

STAR WARS: Galactic Racer™ launches worldwide on October 6th. Pre-order today for PS5.
